author: traveler
text: We arrived at Fushimi Inari and walked beneath the red gates.

author: hana
text: The bamboo grove felt like a different side of Kyoto.

author: traveler
text: We paused beside the river and looked at the bridge.

author: hana
text: I liked taking our time together.

author: traveler
text: The temple hall was our last stop. I would love to return.

author: hana
text: Seeing these places together is what I want to remember.
